input.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
input.rationale: The only limitation-of-liability language in the Agreement (p0077, buried at the end of the Section 12 indemnity) is one-way: it caps TrueLink alone, and leaves Client's liability entirely uncapped notwithstanding the very broad Client indemnity in Sections 12(a)(i)-(iv). That is squarely within the rule's walk-away territory ("Customer's liability uncapped while Vendor's is capped") and fails the fallback, which requires a mutual 12-month fee cap with carve-outs. There is also no mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages anywhere in the document (no hits for "consequential"), and no carve-outs for confidentiality (Section 10) or the parties' indemnification obligations. The redline makes the cap mutual at the greater of 12 months' hosting/support compensation or USD 1,000,000, adds the indirect-damages exclusion, and places indemnification, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap, with Client's payment obligations excluded from "damages". Note the mutual cap replaces the current section-limited TrueLink cap, but TrueLink's uncapped exposure for its own breach is preserved via the Excluded Claims carve-out for its Section 12(b) indemnity.

proposal.summary: Make the liability cap mutual, set it at the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000, and place indemnity, confidentiality, IP and misconduct claims outside the cap.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have made the liability cap mutual and set it at the greater of twelve (12) months' fees or USD 1,000,000, since as drafted only TrueLink enjoys a cap (and only for Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11) while Client's exposure, including under the broad Section 12(a) indemnity, is unlimited. We have also added the standard mutual exclusion of indirect damages and confirmed that indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement claims sit outside the cap, together with Client's payment obligations.

ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID OR PAYABLE BY CLIENT FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD AND (B) USD 1,000,000, AND NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTION 12, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS; CLIENT'S OBLIGATION TO PAY AMOUNTS DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT BE TREATED AS DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION.
